overviewDescription: A clear view of your campaigns, links and audience.
welcomeHint: Create meaningful campaigns. Understand every click.
activityHint: Latest changes to links and campaigns

analyticsDescription: Understand where clicks come from and what performs best.
dateHint: Gregorian dates · UTC reporting buckets · inclusive selected days

signinHint: Use the dashboard password stored in web/.env.local. API keys are never entered here.

noData: No clicks match these filters yet.
